name: Charley Palmer Rothwell
biography: Charley Palmer Rothwell (born 9 February 1992) is an English actor who has appeared in films and television in the United Kingdom. He is the son of EastEnders actress Patsy Palmer. Rothwell was born on 9 February 1992 in Bethnal Green, London. He is the son of actress Patsy Palmer and boxer Alfie Rothwell. He has three half-siblings: Emilia, Fenton and Bertie.
